folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B388: source integration versus playable proof
folds.body:
This complete revision4 checkpoint was read. The four acquisition-to-use families, nineteen commands and native practice/disclosure/report bindings are source integration; the checkpoint explicitly calls the new gameplay implemented-unverified. Build, syntax/import/registration,154 source hashes/152 bundled-local contents and224links/112anchors do not establish player use, rollback, persistence or behavior. Native report visibility, inactive-technique wording and category-map repair are actual integration corrections without newly demonstrated gameplay.

Preserve the later generated/failure/native proof backlog as technical evidence work, with AD42 making human review optional. Old paused/held campaigns, specific worker pool, server/PID, released writers and messages are historical, not a fresh pause, dispatch, live handle or canonical-owner publication. Current PROJECT and the selected task govern build order; no predecessor's test deferral exempts new runtime work under AD36/43. No source, runtime, server, scenario or save was newly exercised here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B388: historical recipes and optional adapter boundaries
folds.body:
The full revision5 amendment text, all four EA packets and later fit qualifier were read. Keep them as historical optional recipes rather than matching old canonical paragraphs or reviving writer assignments. Pinned upstream revisions identify comparison inputs, not installed dependencies or current versions. Reuse actual typed commands, state/effect/native/UI consumers and staged durable publication. A rejected prerequisite pays nothing; a deliberately funded failed experiment can retain its disclosed spent costs. Unsupported capability/target/participant/item/clock links are authoring gaps, not reasons to import a second engine.

Optional Ink needs a demonstrated authoring task and versioned cursor/command/observer contract. Continue, tags, variables and callbacks cannot create mechanical truth outside canonical settlement. Candidate clone, safe projection, stale-choice handling and atomic cursor publication share the actual envelope; dropping a library with live cursors needs a declared resume/archive mapping. File size alone proves neither maintenance nor token savings. Optional rot queries require an actual missing grid decision; supported step-metric A* is not a weighted directed road solver. Sight geometry is not knowledge, consent, reach or guaranteed detection. Positions/topology remain with actual body/instance owners, realized seeded topology persists once, and no foreign scheduler/RNG is adopted.

The small finite batch and roof scenarios remain original proposals rather than new Frontier depth, canon source proof or a required framework. Current AD51 permits a useful first seam; another world validates differences. AD38 allows actual extraordinary means to remove ordinary costs/routes. Compatibility deferral permits a recorded scoped old-state choice but neither private-save deletion nor loss of new-state round trips. Current PROJECT/AD36/42/44/52 supersede old static-only/deferred-test/human-gate sequencing. No dependency, source acquisition, code port, scene or gameplay was selected by this reconciliation.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B388: bounded source capability and two synthetic counterexamples
folds.body:
The full F1–F12 matrix, first-slice contracts, B1–B5 proposed cases and both executed probe bodies/stdout/limitations were read. The historical source audit distinguishes supported bounded paths from partial/gaps; it does not establish absence across the repository. Preserve existing equipment instance/repair, leased observation, body restrictions, completion-support and durable publication capabilities rather than reverting to older blanket “counts only” or “no revalidation” claims. Source-ID copying, scalar repair, room co-location and pause/decision boundaries do not automatically supply exact source-instance transfer, original-form restoration, physical touch or exceptional time semantics.

P1's generated ordinary response applied the same effect as a separately registered unowned power command. This proves those paths do not automatically inherit the same gate, not that every ordinary response must require a power or a shipped response is wrong. P2's pure generic preview exposed an authored formula result from authoritative state without an actor knowledge entry. Purity is not observer safety; the result alone does not prove that current UI renders a secret or that the generated fact is shipped. Both probes are historical in-memory source evidence, not rerun tests, source-canon validation or gameplay. Native/controller response symmetry still needs actual held means and evidence when the selected action represents a power.

Deterministic scheduler order is not source-supported priority for every interaction. Independent per-actor clamping is not conserved paired transfer; overflow/floor handling needs one actual mechanism. Frozen completion effects and opt-in support checks do not establish continuous support or a universal refund/forfeit rule. The selected method determines required support/interruption consequences. Causal deduplication in one branch is not universal idempotency. Preserve exact cause/subject/revision/custody and final-envelope publication for actual new domains, without adding speculative temporal/topology/memory/anatomy systems before the selected first consumer.

Historical line locators, source windows and future same-rule cases retain their own scope. Current AD41's primary-checkout default and actual overlapping writers determine isolation; old mandatory-worktree wording grants no new branch. AD42 makes director fiction/balance review optional; current runtime floors still require the selected native/persistence/failure evidence. No JoJo source text, altered hidden truth, native runtime, import or fresh probe was inspected or executed here, and no campaign or general conceptual-power implementation follows.
